purpose: Phase 5 acceptance: prove or disprove Sepolia-to-Sepolia same-domain Hyperlane delivery, without further chasing it if it fails.
conclusion: Same-domain (Sepolia-to-Sepolia) Hyperlane delivery through the active relayer/validator/ISM configuration is UNPROVEN/UNSUPPORTED for this deployment as of this probe. Per the remediation plan's explicit Phase 5 instruction, this is not being chased further (no relayer restarts, no further funded self-loop tests, no repeated probes). note: The relayer's own whitelist already includes this recipient (see chains/hyperlane-relayer/entrypoint.sh) and the relayer process was not restarted or otherwise touched to run this probe, per the standing constraint against relayer redeploys/config-reload during this remediation window.
